#[global] Declare Scope mctt_scope.

#[global] Delimit Scope mctt_scope with mctt.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with Sortclass.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry judg.

Notation "{{ x }}" := x (at level 0, x custom judg at level 99, format "'{{'  x  '}}'").
=== SYNTAX ===
From Coq Require Import List String.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

Module Cst.

Inductive obj : Set :=
| typ : nat -> obj
| nat : obj
| zero : obj
| succ : obj -> obj
| natrec : obj -> string -> obj -> obj -> string -> string -> obj -> obj
| pi : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| fn : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| app : obj -> obj -> obj
| sigma : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| pair : obj -> obj -> obj -> string -> obj -> obj
| fst : obj -> obj
| snd : obj -> obj
| prop_eq : obj -> obj -> obj -> obj
| refl : obj -> obj -> obj
| eqrec : obj ->
          string -> string -> string -> obj ->
          string -> obj ->
          obj -> obj -> obj -> obj
| var : string -> obj.

End Cst.

Reserved Notation "'typ'".

Inductive exp : Set :=

| a_typ : nat -> typ

| a_nat : typ
| a_zero : exp
| a_succ : exp -> exp
| a_natrec : exp -> typ -> exp -> exp -> exp

| a_pi : typ -> typ -> exp
| a_fn : typ -> exp -> exp
| a_app : exp -> exp -> exp

| a_sigma : exp -> exp -> exp
| a_pair : exp -> typ -> exp -> typ -> exp
| a_fst : exp -> exp
| a_snd : exp -> exp

| a_eq : typ -> exp -> exp -> exp
| a_refl : typ -> exp -> exp
| a_eqrec : exp -> typ -> exp -> exp -> typ -> exp -> exp

| a_var : nat -> exp

| a_sub : exp -> sub -> exp
with sub : Set :=
| a_id : sub
| a_weaken : sub
| a_compose : sub -> sub -> sub
| a_extend : sub -> exp -> sub
where "'typ'" := exp.

Notation ctx := (list exp).

Fixpoint nat_to_exp n : exp :=
  match n with
  | 0 => a_zero
  | S m => a_succ (nat_to_exp m)
  end.

Definition num_to_exp n := nat_to_exp (Nat.of_num_uint n).

Fixpoint exp_to_nat e : option nat :=
  match e with
  | a_zero => Some 0
  | a_succ e' =>
      match exp_to_nat e' with
      | Some n => Some (S n)
      | None => None
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition exp_to_num e :=
  match exp_to_nat e with
  | Some n => Some (Nat.to_num_uint n)
  | None => None
  end.

Inductive nf : Set :=
| nf_typ : nat -> nf
| nf_nat : nf
| nf_zero : nf
| nf_succ : nf -> nf
| nf_pi : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_fn : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_sigma : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_pair : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_eq : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_refl : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_neut : ne -> nf
with ne : Set :=
| ne_natrec : nf -> nf -> nf -> ne -> ne
| ne_app : ne -> nf -> ne
| ne_fst : ne -> ne
| ne_snd : ne -> ne
| ne_var : nat -> ne
| ne_eqrec : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> ne -> ne
.

Fixpoint nf_to_exp (M : nf) : exp :=
  match M with
  | nf_typ i => a_typ i
  | nf_nat => a_nat
  | nf_zero => a_zero
  | nf_succ M => a_succ (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_pi A B => a_pi (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_fn A M => a_fn (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_sigma A B => a_sigma (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => a_pair (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp N) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_eq A M N => a_eq (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp N)
  | nf_refl A M => a_refl (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_neut M => ne_to_exp M
  end
with ne_to_exp (M : ne) : exp :=
  match M with
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M => a_natrec (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp MZ) (nf_to_exp MS) (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_app M N => a_app (ne_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp N)
  | ne_fst M => a_fst (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_snd M => a_snd (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_var x => a_var x
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      a_eqrec (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B) (nf_to_exp BR) (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp M') (ne_to_exp N)
  end
.

Coercion nf_to_exp : nf >-> exp.

Coercion ne_to_exp : ne >-> exp.

Definition q σ := a_extend (a_compose σ a_weaken) (a_var 0).

Arguments q σ/.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry exp.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry nf.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with exp.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with sub.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with nf.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with ne.

Open Scope mctt_scope.

Module Syntax_Notations.

Notation "e [ s ]" := (a_sub e s) (in custom exp at level 0, e custom exp, s custom exp at level 60, left associativity, format "e [ s ]") : mctt_scope.

Notation "{{{ x }}}" := x (at level 0, x custom exp at level 99, format "'{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom exp at level 0, x custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom exp at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom exp at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Type' @ n" := (a_typ n) (in custom exp at level 0, n constr at level 0, format "'Type' @ n") : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := a_nat (in custom exp) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := a_zero (in custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'succ' e" := (a_succ e) (in custom exp at level 1, e custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' e 'return' A | 'zero' -> ez | 'succ' -> es 'end'" := (a_natrec A ez es e) (in custom exp at level 0, A custom exp at level 60, ez custom exp at level 60, es custom exp at level 60, e custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Π' A B" := (a_pi A B) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 0, B custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'λ' A e" := (a_fn A e) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 0, e custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Σ' A B" := (a_sigma A B) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 0, B custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩" := (a_pair M A N B) (in custom exp at level 1, M custom exp at next level, A custom exp at next level, N custom exp at next level, B custom exp at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' M" := (a_fst M) (in custom exp at level 1, M custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' M" := (a_snd M) (in custom exp at level 1, M custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (a_app .. (a_app f x) .. y) (in custom exp at level 40, f custom exp, x custom exp at next level, y custom exp at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' A M N" := (a_eq A M N) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 30, M custom exp at level 35, N custom exp at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'refl' A M" := (a_refl A M) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 30, M custom exp at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'eqrec' N 'as' 'Eq' A M1 M2 'return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end'" := (a_eqrec A B BR M1 M2 N) (in custom exp at level 0, A custom exp at level 30, B custom exp at level 60, BR custom exp at level 60, M1 custom exp at level 35, M2 custom exp at level 40, N custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'#' n" := (a_var n) (in custom exp at level 0, n constr at level 0, format "'#' n") : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Id'" := a_id (in custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Wk'" := a_weaken (in custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "σ ∘ τ" := (a_compose σ τ) (in custom exp at level 40, right associativity, format "σ ∘ τ") : mctt_scope.

Notation "σ ,, e" := (a_extend σ e) (in custom exp at level 50, left associativity, format "σ ,, e") : mctt_scope.

Notation "'q' σ" := (q σ) (in custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⋅" := nil (in custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x , y" := (cons y x) (in custom exp at level 50, left associativity, format "x ,  y") : mctt_scope.

Notation "n{{{ x }}}" := x (at level 0, x custom nf at level 99, format "'n{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom nf at level 0, x custom nf at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom nf at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom nf at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Type' @ n" := (nf_typ n) (in custom nf at level 0, n constr at level 0, format "'Type' @ n") : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := nf_nat (in custom nf) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := nf_zero (in custom nf at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'succ' M" := (nf_succ M) (in custom nf at level 2, M custom nf at level 1) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' M 'return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end'" := (ne_natrec A MZ MS M) (in custom nf at level 0, A custom nf at level 60, MZ custom nf at level 60, MS custom nf at level 60, M custom nf at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Π' A B" := (nf_pi A B) (in custom nf at level 2, A custom nf at level 1, B custom nf at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'λ' A e" := (nf_fn A e) (in custom nf at level 2, A custom nf at level 1, e custom nf at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Σ' A B" := (nf_sigma A B) (in custom nf at level 2, A custom nf at level 1, B custom nf at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩" := (nf_pair M A N B) (in custom nf at level 2, M custom nf at level 1, A custom nf at level 60, N custom nf at level 60, B custom nf at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (ne_app .. (ne_app f x) .. y) (in custom nf at level 40, f custom nf, x custom nf at next level, y custom nf at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' M" := (ne_fst M) (in custom nf at level 2, M custom nf at level 1) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' M" := (ne_snd M) (in custom nf at level 2, M custom nf at level 1) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' A M N" := (nf_eq A M N) (in custom nf at level 1, A custom nf at level 30, M custom nf at level 35, N custom nf at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'refl' A M" := (nf_refl A M) (in custom nf at level 1, A custom nf at level 30, M custom nf at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'eqrec' N 'as' 'Eq' A M1 M2 'return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end'" := (ne_eqrec A B BR M1 M2 N) (in custom nf at level 0, A custom nf at level 30, B custom nf at level 60, BR custom nf at level 60, M1 custom nf at level 35, M2 custom nf at level 40, N custom nf at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'#' n" := (ne_var n) (in custom nf at level 0, n constr at level 0, format "'#' n") : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑' M" := (nf_neut M) (in custom nf at level 0, M custom nf at level 99, format "'⇑'  M") : mctt_scope.

End Syntax_Notations.

| ne_fst : ne -> ne
| ne_snd : ne -> ne
| ne_var : nat -> ne
| ne_eqrec : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> ne -> ne
.

Fixpoint nf_to_exp (M : nf) : exp :=
  match M with
  | nf_typ i => a_typ i
  | nf_nat => a_nat
  | nf_zero => a_zero
  | nf_succ M => a_succ (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_pi A B => a_pi (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_fn A M => a_fn (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_sigma A B => a_sigma (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => a_pair (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp N) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_eq A M N => a_eq (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp N)
  | nf_refl A M => a_refl (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_neut M => ne_to_exp M
  end
with ne_to_exp (M : ne) : exp :=
  match M with
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M => a_natrec (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp MZ) (nf_to_exp MS) (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_app M N => a_app (ne_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp N)
  | ne_fst M => a_fst (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_snd M => a_snd (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_var x => a_var x
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      a_eqrec (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B) (nf_to_exp BR) (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp M') (ne_to_exp N)
  end
.

Coercion nf_to_exp : nf >-> exp.

Coercion ne_to_exp : ne >-> exp.

Definition q σ := a_extend (a_compose σ a_weaken) (a_var 0).

Arguments q σ/.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry exp.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry nf.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with exp.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with sub.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with nf.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with ne.

Open Scope mctt_scope.

Module Syntax_Notations.

Notation "e [ s ]" := (a_sub e s) (in custom exp at level 0, e custom exp, s custom exp at level 60, left associativity, format "e [ s ]") : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := a_zero (in custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' e 'return' A | 'zero' -> ez | 'succ' -> es 'end'" := (a_natrec A ez es e) (in custom exp at level 0, A custom exp at level 60, ez custom exp at level 60, es custom exp at level 60, e custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (a_app .. (a_app f x) .. y) (in custom exp at level 40, f custom exp, x custom exp at next level, y custom exp at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' A M N" := (a_eq A M N) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 30, M custom exp at level 35, N custom exp at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (ne_app .. (ne_app f x) .. y) (in custom nf at level 40, f custom nf, x custom nf at next level, y custom nf at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' M" := (ne_fst M) (in custom nf at level 2, M custom nf at level 1) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' M" := (ne_snd M) (in custom nf at level 2, M custom nf at level 1) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' A M N" := (nf_eq A M N) (in custom nf at level 1, A custom nf at level 30, M custom nf at level 35, N custom nf at level 40) : mctt_scope.

From Equations Require Import Equations.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Reserved Notation "'env'".

Inductive domain : Set :=
| d_univ : nat -> domain
| d_nat : domain
| d_zero : domain
| d_succ : domain -> domain
| d_pi : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_fn : env -> exp -> domain
| d_sigma : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_pair : domain -> domain -> domain
| d_eq : domain -> domain -> domain -> domain
| d_refl : domain -> domain
| d_neut : domain -> domain_ne -> domain
with domain_ne : Set :=




| d_var : forall (x : nat), domain_ne
| d_app : domain_ne -> domain_nf -> domain_ne
| d_fst : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_snd : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_natrec : env -> typ -> domain -> exp -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_eqrec : env -> domain -> typ -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
with domain_nf : Set :=
| d_dom : domain -> domain -> domain_nf
where "'env'" := (nat -> domain).

Definition empty_env : env := fun x => d_zero.

Arguments empty_env _ /.

Definition extend_env (ρ : env) (d : domain) : env :=
  fun n =>
    match n with
    | 0 => d
    | S n' => ρ n'
    end.

Arguments extend_env _ _ _ /.

Definition drop_env (ρ : env) : env := fun n => ρ (S n).

Arguments drop_env _ _ /.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry domain.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with domain.

Module Domain_Notations.

Export Syntax_Notations.

Notation "'d{{{' x '}}}'" := x (at level 0, x custom domain at level 99, format "'d{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'𝕌' @ n" := (d_univ n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := d_nat (in custom domain) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := d_zero (in custom domain at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'succ' m" := (d_succ m) (in custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' m 'under' ρ 'return' P | 'zero' -> mz | 'succ' -> MS 'end'" := (d_natrec ρ P mz MS m) (in custom domain at level 0, P custom exp at level 60, mz custom domain at level 60, MS custom exp at level 60, ρ custom domain at level 60, m custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Π' a ρ B" := (d_pi a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'λ' ρ M" := (d_fn ρ M) (in custom domain at level 0, ρ custom domain at level 30, M custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (d_app .. (d_app f x) .. y) (in custom domain at level 40, f custom domain, x custom domain at next level, y custom domain at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Σ' a ρ B" := (d_sigma a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⟨ a ; b ⟩ " := (d_pair a b) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, b custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' e" := (d_fst e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' e" := (d_snd e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' a m n" := (d_eq a m n) (in custom domain at level 1, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 35, n custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'refl' m" := (d_refl m) (in custom domain at level 1, m custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'eqrec' n 'under' ρ 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 'return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end'" := (d_eqrec ρ a B BR m1 m2 n) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, B custom exp at level 60, BR custom exp at level 60, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, n custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'!' n" := (d_var n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑' a m" := (d_neut a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇓' a m" := (d_dom a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑!' a n" := (d_neut a (d_var n)) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ ↦ m" := (extend_env ρ m) (in custom domain at level 20, left associativity) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ '↯'" := (drop_env ρ) (in custom domain at level 10, ρ custom domain) : mctt_scope.

End Domain_Notations.

Import Domain_Notations.
=== EVAL DEFS ===
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'⟦' M '⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, M custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, A custom exp at level 99, MZ custom exp at level 99, MS custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₁' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₂' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, a custom domain at level 30, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, B custom exp at level 99, BR custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" (in custom judg at level 80, σ custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, ρσ custom domain at level 99).

Generalizable All Variables.

Variant eval_fst : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_fst_pair :
  `( {{ π₁ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ a }} )
| eval_fst_neut :
  `( {{ π₁ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ a (fst m) }} )
where "'π₁' n '↘' r" := (eval_fst n r) (in custom judg).

Inductive eval_exp : exp -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_exp_typ :
  `( {{ ⟦ Type@i ⟧ ρ ↘ 𝕌@i }} )
| eval_exp_var :
  `( {{ ⟦ # x ⟧ ρ ↘ ^(ρ x) }} )
| eval_exp_nat :
  `( {{ ⟦ ℕ ⟧ ρ ↘ ℕ }} )
| eval_exp_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ zero ⟧ ρ ↘ zero }} )
| eval_exp_succ :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ succ M ⟧ ρ ↘ succ m }} )
| eval_exp_natrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ rec m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_pi :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Π A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Π a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ λ A M ⟧ ρ ↘ λ ρ M }} )
| eval_exp_app :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ $| m & n |↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M N ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sigma :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Σ A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Σ a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_pair :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ b }} ->
     {{ ⟦ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ⟧ ρ ↘ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ }} )
| eval_exp_fst :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ fst M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_snd :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ snd M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_eq :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Eq A M1 M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ Eq a m1 m2 }} )
| eval_exp_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ refl A M ⟧ ρ ↘ refl m }} )
| eval_exp_eqrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ eqrec n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sub :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ' ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} )
where "'⟦' e '⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_exp e ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_natrec : exp -> exp -> exp -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_natrec_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ rec zero ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} )
| eval_natrec_succ :
  `( {{ rec b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ b ↦ r ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ rec succ b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ms }} )
| eval_natrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ b m ↘ a }} ->
     {{ rec ⇑ b m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ a (rec m under ρ return A | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end) }} )
where "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_app : domain -> domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_app_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ m }} ->
     {{ $| λ ρ M & n |↘ m }} )
| eval_app_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ $| ⇑ (Π a ρ B) m & n |↘ ⇑ b (m (⇓ a n)) }} )
where "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" := (eval_app m n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_snd : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_snd_pair :
  `( {{ π₂ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ b }} )
| eval_snd_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ a (fst m) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ π₂ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ b (snd m) }} )
where "'π₂' n '↘' r" := (eval_snd n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_eqrec : domain -> exp -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_eqrec_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ br }} ->
     {{ eqrec refl n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ br }} )
| eval_eqrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m1 ↦ m2 ↦ ⇑ c n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ eqrec ⇑ c n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ b (eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end) }} )
where "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_sub : sub -> env -> env -> Prop :=
| eval_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⟦ Id ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ }} )
| eval_sub_weaken :
  `( {{ ⟦ Wk ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ ↯ }} )
| eval_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ,, M ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ↦ m }} )
| eval_sub_compose :
  `( {{ ⟦ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρτ ↘ ρτσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ∘ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτσ }} )
where "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" := (eval_sub σ ρ ρσ) (in custom judg)
.

Scheme eval_exp_mut_ind := Induction for eval_exp Sort Prop
with eval_natrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_natrec Sort Prop
with eval_app_mut_ind := Induction for eval_app Sort Prop
with eval_snd_mut_ind := Induction for eval_snd Sort Prop
with eval_eqrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_eqrec Sort Prop
with eval_sub_mut_ind := Induction for eval_sub Sort Prop
.

Combined Scheme eval_mut_ind from
  eval_exp_mut_ind,
  eval_natrec_mut_ind,
  eval_app_mut_ind,
  eval_snd_mut_ind,
  eval_eqrec_mut_ind,
  eval_sub_mut_ind.

Inductive domain : Set :=
| d_univ : nat -> domain
| d_nat : domain
| d_zero : domain
| d_succ : domain -> domain
| d_pi : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_fn : env -> exp -> domain
| d_sigma : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_pair : domain -> domain -> domain
| d_eq : domain -> domain -> domain -> domain
| d_refl : domain -> domain
| d_neut : domain -> domain_ne -> domain
with domain_ne : Set :=




| d_var : forall (x : nat), domain_ne
| d_app : domain_ne -> domain_nf -> domain_ne
| d_fst : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_snd : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_natrec : env -> typ -> domain -> exp -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_eqrec : env -> domain -> typ -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
with domain_nf : Set :=
| d_dom : domain -> domain -> domain_nf
where "'env'" := (nat -> domain).

Definition empty_env : env := fun x => d_zero.

Arguments empty_env _ /.

Definition extend_env (ρ : env) (d : domain) : env :=
  fun n =>
    match n with
    | 0 => d
    | S n' => ρ n'
    end.

Arguments extend_env _ _ _ /.

Definition drop_env (ρ : env) : env := fun n => ρ (S n).

Arguments drop_env _ _ /.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry domain.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with domain.

Module Domain_Notations.

Export Syntax_Notations.

Notation "'d{{{' x '}}}'" := x (at level 0, x custom domain at level 99, format "'d{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'𝕌' @ n" := (d_univ n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := d_nat (in custom domain) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := d_zero (in custom domain at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'succ' m" := (d_succ m) (in custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' m 'under' ρ 'return' P | 'zero' -> mz | 'succ' -> MS 'end'" := (d_natrec ρ P mz MS m) (in custom domain at level 0, P custom exp at level 60, mz custom domain at level 60, MS custom exp at level 60, ρ custom domain at level 60, m custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Π' a ρ B" := (d_pi a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'λ' ρ M" := (d_fn ρ M) (in custom domain at level 0, ρ custom domain at level 30, M custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (d_app .. (d_app f x) .. y) (in custom domain at level 40, f custom domain, x custom domain at next level, y custom domain at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Σ' a ρ B" := (d_sigma a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⟨ a ; b ⟩ " := (d_pair a b) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, b custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' e" := (d_fst e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' e" := (d_snd e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' a m n" := (d_eq a m n) (in custom domain at level 1, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 35, n custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'refl' m" := (d_refl m) (in custom domain at level 1, m custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'eqrec' n 'under' ρ 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 'return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end'" := (d_eqrec ρ a B BR m1 m2 n) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, B custom exp at level 60, BR custom exp at level 60, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, n custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'!' n" := (d_var n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑' a m" := (d_neut a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇓' a m" := (d_dom a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑!' a n" := (d_neut a (d_var n)) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ ↦ m" := (extend_env ρ m) (in custom domain at level 20, left associativity) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ '↯'" := (drop_env ρ) (in custom domain at level 10, ρ custom domain) : mctt_scope.

End Domain_Notations.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'⟦' M '⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, M custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, A custom exp at level 99, MZ custom exp at level 99, MS custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₁' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₂' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, a custom domain at level 30, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, B custom exp at level 99, BR custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" (in custom judg at level 80, σ custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, ρσ custom domain at level 99).

Generalizable All Variables.

Variant eval_fst : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_fst_pair :
  `( {{ π₁ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ a }} )
| eval_fst_neut :
  `( {{ π₁ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ a (fst m) }} )
where "'π₁' n '↘' r" := (eval_fst n r) (in custom judg).

Inductive eval_exp : exp -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_exp_typ :
  `( {{ ⟦ Type@i ⟧ ρ ↘ 𝕌@i }} )
| eval_exp_var :
  `( {{ ⟦ # x ⟧ ρ ↘ ^(ρ x) }} )
| eval_exp_nat :
  `( {{ ⟦ ℕ ⟧ ρ ↘ ℕ }} )
| eval_exp_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ zero ⟧ ρ ↘ zero }} )
| eval_exp_succ :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ succ M ⟧ ρ ↘ succ m }} )
| eval_exp_natrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ rec m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_pi :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Π A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Π a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ λ A M ⟧ ρ ↘ λ ρ M }} )
| eval_exp_app :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ $| m & n |↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M N ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sigma :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Σ A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Σ a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_pair :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ b }} ->
     {{ ⟦ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ⟧ ρ ↘ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ }} )
| eval_exp_fst :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ fst M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_snd :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ snd M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_eq :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Eq A M1 M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ Eq a m1 m2 }} )
| eval_exp_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ refl A M ⟧ ρ ↘ refl m }} )
| eval_exp_eqrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ eqrec n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sub :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ' ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} )
where "'⟦' e '⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_exp e ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_natrec : exp -> exp -> exp -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_natrec_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ rec zero ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} )
| eval_natrec_succ :
  `( {{ rec b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ b ↦ r ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ rec succ b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ms }} )
| eval_natrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ b m ↘ a }} ->
     {{ rec ⇑ b m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ a (rec m under ρ return A | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end) }} )
where "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_app : domain -> domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_app_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ m }} ->
     {{ $| λ ρ M & n |↘ m }} )
| eval_app_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ $| ⇑ (Π a ρ B) m & n |↘ ⇑ b (m (⇓ a n)) }} )
where "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" := (eval_app m n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_snd : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_snd_pair :
  `( {{ π₂ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ b }} )
| eval_snd_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ a (fst m) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ π₂ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ b (snd m) }} )
where "'π₂' n '↘' r" := (eval_snd n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_eqrec : domain -> exp -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_eqrec_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ br }} ->
     {{ eqrec refl n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ br }} )
| eval_eqrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m1 ↦ m2 ↦ ⇑ c n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ eqrec ⇑ c n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ b (eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end) }} )
where "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_sub : sub -> env -> env -> Prop :=
| eval_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⟦ Id ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ }} )
| eval_sub_weaken :
  `( {{ ⟦ Wk ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ ↯ }} )
| eval_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ,, M ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ↦ m }} )
| eval_sub_compose :
  `( {{ ⟦ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρτ ↘ ρτσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ∘ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτσ }} )
where "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" := (eval_sub σ ρ ρσ) (in custom judg)
.

Scheme eval_exp_mut_ind := Induction for eval_exp Sort Prop
with eval_natrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_natrec Sort Prop
with eval_app_mut_ind := Induction for eval_app Sort Prop
with eval_snd_mut_ind := Induction for eval_snd Sort Prop
with eval_eqrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_eqrec Sort Prop
with eval_sub_mut_ind := Induction for eval_sub Sort Prop
.

Combined Scheme eval_mut_ind from
  eval_exp_mut_ind,
  eval_natrec_mut_ind,
  eval_app_mut_ind,
  eval_snd_mut_ind,
  eval_eqrec_mut_ind,
  eval_sub_mut_ind.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Import Evaluation.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive read_nf : nat -> domain_nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_nf_type :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ 𝕌@i a in s ↘ A }} )
| read_nf_zero :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ zero in s ↘ zero }} )
| read_nf_succ :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (succ m) in s ↘ succ M }} )
| read_nf_nat_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (⇑ a m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
| read_nf_fn :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ $| m & ⇑! a s |↘ m' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ b m' in S s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Π a ρ B) m in s ↘ λ A M }} )
| read_nf_sigma :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ m' }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ n }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m' ↘ b' }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ b' n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Σ a ρ B) m in s ↘ ⟨M : A ; N : B'⟩}} )
| read_nf_refl :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M' }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (refl m') in s ↘ refl A M' }} )
| read_nf_eq_neut :
  `( {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (⇑ b n) in s ↘ ⇑ N }} )
| read_nf_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (⇑ a b) (⇑ c m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
where "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_nf s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_ne : nat -> domain_ne -> ne -> Prop :=
| read_ne_var :
  `( {{ Rne !x in s ↘ #(s - x - 1) }} )
| read_ne_natrec :
  `(
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ zero ↘ bz }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ succ (⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }} ->

     {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end in s ↘ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }} )
| read_ne_app :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne m n in s ↘ M N }} )
| read_ne_fst :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (fst m) in s ↘ fst M }} )
| read_ne_snd :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (snd m) in s ↘ snd M }} )
| read_ne_eqrec :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a (S s) ↦ ⇑! (Eq a (⇑! a s) (⇑! a (S s))) (S (S s)) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S (S (S s)) ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ refl (⇑! a s) ↘ bbr }} ->
     {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ br }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bbr br in S s ↘ BR' }} ->

     {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end in s ↘ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B' | refl -> BR' end }} )
where "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_ne s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_typ : nat -> domain -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_typ_univ :
  `( {{ Rtyp 𝕌@i in s ↘ Type@i }} )
| read_typ_nat :
  `( {{ Rtyp ℕ in s ↘ ℕ }} )
| read_typ_pi :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Π a ρ B in s ↘ Π A B' }})
| read_typ_sigma :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Σ a ρ B in s ↘ Σ A B' }})
| read_typ_eq :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Eq a m1 m2 in s ↘ Eq A M1 M2 }})
| read_typ_neut :
  `( {{ Rne b in s ↘ B }} ->
     {{ Rtyp ⇑ a b in s ↘ ⇑ B }})
where "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_typ s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
.

Scheme read_nf_mut_ind := Induction for read_nf Sort Prop
with read_ne_mut_ind := Induction for read_ne Sort Prop
with read_typ_mut_ind := Induction for read_typ Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme read_mut_ind from
  read_nf_mut_ind,
  read_ne_mut_ind,
  read_typ_mut_ind.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain Evaluation Readback.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export System.

Import Domain_Notations.

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive initial_env : ctx -> env -> Prop :=
| initial_env_nil : initial_env nil empty_env
| initial_env_cons :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     initial_env (A :: Γ) d{{{ ρ ↦ ⇑! a (length Γ) }}}).

Inductive nbe : ctx -> exp -> typ -> nf -> Prop :=
| nbe_run :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m in (length Γ) ↘ w }} ->
     nbe Γ M A w ).

Inductive nbe_ty : ctx -> typ -> nf -> Prop :=
| nbe_ty_run :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ Rtyp m in (length Γ) ↘ W }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ M W ).

     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Π a ρ B) m in s ↘ λ A M }} )
| read_nf_sigma :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ m' }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ n }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m' ↘ b' }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ b' n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Σ a ρ B) m in s ↘ ⟨M : A ; N : B'⟩}} )
| read_nf_refl :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M' }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (refl m') in s ↘ refl A M' }} )
| read_nf_eq_neut :
  `( {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (⇑ b n) in s ↘ ⇑ N }} )
| read_nf_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (⇑ a b) (⇑ c m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
where "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_nf s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_ne : nat -> domain_ne -> ne -> Prop :=
| read_ne_var :
  `( {{ Rne !x in s ↘ #(s - x - 1) }} )
| read_ne_natrec :
  `(
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ zero ↘ bz }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ succ (⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }} ->

     {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end in s ↘ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }} )
| read_ne_app :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne m n in s ↘ M N }} )
| read_ne_fst :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (fst m) in s ↘ fst M }} )
| read_ne_snd :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (snd m) in s ↘ snd M }} )
| read_ne_eqrec :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a (S s) ↦ ⇑! (Eq a (⇑! a s) (⇑! a (S s))) (S (S s)) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S (S (S s)) ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ refl (⇑! a s) ↘ bbr }} ->
     {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ br }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bbr br in S s ↘ BR' }} ->

     {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end in s ↘ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B' | refl -> BR' end }} )
where "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_ne s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_typ : nat -> domain -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_typ_univ :
  `( {{ Rtyp 𝕌@i in s ↘ Type@i }} )
| read_typ_nat :
  `( {{ Rtyp ℕ in s ↘ ℕ }} )
| read_typ_pi :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Π a ρ B in s ↘ Π A B' }})
| read_typ_sigma :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Σ a ρ B in s ↘ Σ A B' }})
| read_typ_eq :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Eq a m1 m2 in s ↘ Eq A M1 M2 }})
| read_typ_neut :
  `( {{ Rne b in s ↘ B }} ->
     {{ Rtyp ⇑ a b in s ↘ ⇑ B }})
where "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_typ s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
.

Scheme read_nf_mut_ind := Induction for read_nf Sort Prop
with read_ne_mut_ind := Induction for read_ne Sort Prop
with read_typ_mut_ind := Induction for read_typ Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme read_mut_ind from
  read_nf_mut_ind,
  read_ne_mut_ind,
  read_typ_mut_ind.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain Evaluation Readback.

Import Domain_Notations.

Generalizable All Variables.

| initial_env_nil : initial_env nil empty_env
| initial_env_cons :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     initial_env (A :: Γ) d{{{ ρ ↦ ⇑! a (length Γ) }}}).

  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->

| nbe_ty_run :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->

     nbe_ty Γ M W ).

From Coq Require Import List Classes.RelationClasses Setoid Morphisms.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Import Syntax_Notations.

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ ≈ Γ'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, Γ' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, M' custom exp, A custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ M : A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢s σ : Δ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, σ custom exp, Δ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, σ custom exp, σ' custom exp, Δ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ ⊆ Γ'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, Γ' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, A custom exp, A' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "'#' x : A ∈ Γ" (in custom judg at level 80, x constr at level 0, A custom exp, Γ custom exp at level 50).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive ctx_lookup : nat -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
  | here : `({{ #0 : A[Wk] ∈ Γ, A }})
  | there : `({{ #n : A ∈ Γ }} -> {{ #(S n) : A[Wk] ∈ Γ, B }})
where "'#' x : A ∈ Γ" := (ctx_lookup x A Γ) (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Inductive wf_ctx : ctx -> Prop :=
| wf_ctx_empty : {{ ⊢ ⋅ }}
| wf_ctx_extend :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Γ, A }} )
where "⊢ Γ" := (wf_ctx Γ) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_ctx_sub : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| wf_ctx_sub_empty : {{ ⊢ ⋅ ⊆ ⋅ }}
| wf_ctx_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ ⊆ Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Γ, A ⊆ Δ, A' }} )
where "⊢ Γ ⊆ Γ'" := (wf_ctx_sub Γ Γ') (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_exp : ctx -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
| wf_typ :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i : Type@(S i) }} )

| wf_nat :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }} )
| wf_zero :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ zero : ℕ }} )
| wf_succ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ succ M : ℕ }} )
| wf_natrec :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end : A[Id,,M] }} )

| wf_pi :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Π A B : Type@i }} )
| wf_fn :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ λ A M : Π A B }} )
| wf_app :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M N : B[Id,,N] }} )

| wf_sigma :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A B : Type@i }} )
| wf_pair :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ : Σ A B }} )
| wf_fst :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ fst M : A }} )
| wf_snd :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd M : B[Id,,fst M] }} )

| wf_vlookup :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ #x : A }} )

| wf_eq :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Eq A M N : Type@i }})
| wf_refl :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ refl A M : Eq A M M }})
| wf_eqrec :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ BR : B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end : B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }} )

| wf_exp_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] : A[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_subtyp :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->









     {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A' }} )
where "Γ ⊢ M : A" := (wf_exp Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_sub : ctx -> ctx -> sub -> Prop :=
| wf_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }} )
| wf_sub_weaken :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ, A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }} )
| wf_sub_compose :
  `( {{ Γ1 ⊢s σ2 : Γ2 }} ->
     {{ Γ2 ⊢s σ1 : Γ3 }} ->
     {{ Γ1 ⊢s σ1∘σ2 : Γ3 }} )
| wf_sub_extend :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A[σ] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢s σ,,M : Δ, A }} )
| wf_sub_subtyp :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->




     {{ ⊢ Δ' }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Δ ⊆ Δ' }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ' }} )
where "Γ ⊢s σ : Δ" := (wf_sub Γ Δ σ) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_exp_eq : ctx -> typ -> exp -> exp -> Prop :=
| wf_exp_eq_typ_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i[σ] ≈ Type@i : Type@(S i) }} )

| wf_exp_eq_nat_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ[σ] ≈ ℕ : Type@0 }} )
| wf_exp_eq_zero_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ zero[σ] ≈ zero : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_succ_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (succ M)[σ] ≈ succ (M[σ]) : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_succ_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ succ M ≈ succ M' : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_natrec_cong :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ ≈ MZ' : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS ≈ MS' : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ rec M' return A' | zero -> MZ' | succ -> MS' end : A[Id,,M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_natrec_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Δ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end[σ] ≈ rec M[σ] return A[q σ] | zero -> MZ[σ] | succ -> MS[q (q σ)] end : A[σ,,M[σ]] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_nat_beta_zero :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec zero return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_nat_beta_succ :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec succ M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ MS[Id,,M,,rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end] : A[Id,,succ M] }} )

| wf_exp_eq_pi_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (Π A B)[σ] ≈ Π A[σ] B[q σ] : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pi_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Π A B ≈ Π A' B' : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fn_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M ≈ M' : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ λ A M ≈ λ A' M' : Π A B }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fn_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (λ A M)[σ] ≈ λ A[σ] M[q σ] : (Π A B)[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_app_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M N ≈ M' N' : B[Id,,N] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_app_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (M N)[σ] ≈ M[σ] N[σ] : B[σ,,N[σ]] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pi_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (λ A M) N ≈ M[Id,,N] : B[Id,,N] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pi_eta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ λ A (M[Wk] #0) : Π A B }} )

| wf_exp_eq_sigma_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (Σ A B)[σ] ≈ Σ A[σ] B[q σ] : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_sigma_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A B ≈ Σ A' B' : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pair_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ≈ ⟨ M' : A' ; N' : B' ⟩ : Σ A B }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pair_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩[σ] ≈ ⟨ M[σ] : A[σ] ; N[σ] : B[q σ] ⟩ : (Σ A B)[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fst_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ fst M ≈ fst M' : A }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fst_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (fst M)[σ] ≈ fst (M[σ]) : A[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd M ≈ snd M' : B[Id,,fst M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (snd M)[σ] ≈ snd (M[σ]) : B[σ,,fst (M[σ])] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fst_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ fst (⟨ M : A ; N : B⟩) ≈ M : A }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ≈ N : B[Id,,M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_sigma_eta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ ⟨ fst M : A ; snd M : B ⟩ : Σ A B }} )

| wf_exp_eq_eq_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq A M N)[σ] ≈ Eq A[σ] M[σ] N[σ] : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_refl_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->

import re
lines=open('/workspace/Checks.out').read().splitlines()
entries=[]
cur=None
for ln in lines:
    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', ln.strip()) and not ln.startswith(' '):
        if cur: entries.append(cur)
        cur=[ln.strip(),'']
    elif cur is not None:
        cur[1]+=' '+ln.strip()
if cur: entries.append(cur)
out=[]
for name,text in entries:
    t=text.strip()
    if t.startswith(': '): t=t[2:]
    # strip leading forall groups
    nb=0
    while True:
        t=t.strip()
        m=re.match(r'forall\s*\((.*?)\)\s*,', t, re.S)
        if not m: break
        group=m.group(1)
        # count names: split on spaces, names are before ':' tokens; handle groups like "Γ Δ : ctx"
        # remove type annotations: split by ':' at top level (no nested parens in these)
        parts=group.split(':')
        nms=parts[0].split()
        nb+=len(nms)
        t=t[m.end():].strip()
    # count premises: top-level '->'
    prem=t.count('->')
    out.append((name,nb,prem,t))
for name,nb,prem,t in out:
    print(f'Arguments {name} ' + '{'+' '.join(['_']*nb)+'} ' + ' '.join(['_']*prem)+'.')

import re
lines=open('/workspace/Checks.out').read().splitlines()
entries=[]; cur=None
for ln in lines:
    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', ln.strip()) and not ln.startswith(' '):
        if cur: entries.append(cur)
        cur=[ln.strip(),'']
    elif cur is not None:
        cur[1]+=' '+ln.strip()
if cur: entries.append(cur)

def parse_sig(t):
    t=t.strip()
    if t.startswith(': '): t=t[2:]
    nb=0
    while True:
        t=t.strip()
        if not t.startswith('forall'): break
        t=t[len('forall'):].strip()
        # parse one or more paren groups
        while t.startswith('('):
            depth=0; i=0
            while i<len(t):
                if t[i]=='(': depth+=1
                elif t[i]==')':
                    depth-=1
                    if depth==0: break
                i+=1
            group=t[1:i]
            before=group.split(':')[0]
            nb+=len(before.split())
            t=t[i+1:].strip()
        if t.startswith(','): t=t[1:].strip()
    prem=t.count('->')
    return nb,prem,t

out=[]
for name,text in entries:
    nb,prem,t=parse_sig(text)
    out.append(f'Arguments {name} '+'{'+' '.join(['_']*nb)+'}'+(' '+' '.join(['_']*prem) if prem else '')+'.')
print('\n'.join(out))

  (exists a W, {{ ⟦A⟧ ρσ ↘ a }} /\ {{ ⟦ M[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} /\

Definition SubReal (Γ : ctx) (ρ : env) (Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρσ : env) : Prop :=
  forall (x : nat) (A : typ), {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->

                {{ Rnf a (ρ x) in (length Γ) ↘ W }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ #x[id] ≈ W : A[id] }}.

  {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ zero : ℕ[σ] }} ->
  Real Γ ρ Δ a_nat σ ρσ M m.
Proof. intros. unfold Real. simpl. split.
  - exists d{{{ ℕ }}}, n{{{ zero }}}. repeat split; assumption.

        wf_exp Δ A0 N ->

          eval_exp A0 ρσ a0 /\
          eval_app m n r /\

  | _ => True

Definition SubReal (Γ : ctx) (ρ : env) (Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρσ : env) : Prop :=

EOF

Fixpoint vshift (k : nat) (v v' : domain) : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' => match v, v' with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_zero, d_zero => True
    | d_succ x, d_succ x' => vshift k' x x'
    | d_pi a ρ B, d_pi a' ρ' B' => B = B' /\ vshift k' a a' /\ (forall n, vshift k' (ρ n) (ρ' n))
    | d_fn ρ M, d_fn ρ' M' => M = M' /\ (forall n, vshift k' (ρ n) (ρ' n))
    ...
    | d_neut a ne, d_neut a' ne' => vshift k' a a' /\ nshift k' ne ne'
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with nshift (k) (ne ne' : domain_ne) : Prop := ...
```

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export NbE.
Import Domain_Notations.

(* Renaming of neutral variable levels in semantic values, with a fuel bound
   and an index renaming for stored environments. *)
Fixpoint vren (k : nat) (f g : nat -> nat) (v v' : domain) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match v, v' with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_zero, d_zero => True
    | d_succ a, d_succ a' => vren k' f g a a'
    | d_pi a ρ B, d_pi a' ρ' B' => B = B' /\ vren k' f g a a' /\ eren k' f g ρ ρ'
    | d_fn ρ M, d_fn ρ' M' => M = M' /\ eren k' f g ρ ρ'
    | d_sigma a ρ B, d_sigma a' ρ' B' => B = B' /\ vren k' f g a a' /\ eren k' f g ρ ρ'
    | d_pair a b, d_pair a' b' => vren k' f g a a' /\ vren k' f g b b'
    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' => vren k' f g a a' /\ vren k' f g m1 m1' /\ vren k' f g m2 m2'
    | d_refl a, d_refl a' => vren k' f g a a'
    | d_neut a ne, d_neut a' ne' => vren k' f g a a' /\ nren k' f g ne ne'
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with eren (k : nat) (f g : nat -> nat) (ρ ρ' : env) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' => forall i, vren k' f g (ρ i) (ρ' (g i))
  end
with nren (k : nat) (f g : nat -> nat) (ne ne' : domain_ne) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match ne, ne' with
    | d_var x, d_var x' => x' = f x
    | d_app m n, d_app m' n' => nren k' f g m m' /\ nfren k' f g n n'
    | d_fst m, d_fst m' => nren k' f g m m'
    | d_snd m, d_snd m' => nren k' f g m m'
    | d_natrec ρ B mz MS m, d_natrec ρ' B' mz' MS' m' =>
        B = B' /\ MS = MS' /\ eren k' f g ρ ρ' /\ vren k' f g mz mz' /\ nren k' f g m m'
    | d_eqrec ρ a B BR m1 m2 m, d_eqrec ρ' a' B' BR' m1' m2' m' =>
        B = B' /\ BR = BR' /\ eren k' f g ρ ρ' /\ vren k' f g a a' /\
        vren k' f g m1 m1' /\ vren k' f g m2 m2' /\ nren k' f g m m'
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with nfren (k : nat) (f g : nat -> nat) (n n' : domain_nf) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match n, n' with
    | d_dom a v, d_dom a' v' => vren k' f g a a' /\ vren k' f g v v'
    end
  end.
EOF

| hr_ctx_empty : hr_ctx wf_ctx_empty 1
| hr_ctx_extend : forall Γ i A (w : {{ ⊢ Γ }}) n (wA : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}) m,

with hr_exp : forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> nat -> Prop :=
| hr_typ : forall Γ i (w : {{ ⊢ Γ }}) n,
    hr_ctx w n -> hr_exp (wf_typ Γ i w) (101 + n)
| hr_nat : forall Γ (w : {{ ⊢ Γ }}) n,
    hr_ctx w n -> hr_exp (wf_nat Γ w) (101 + n)
| hr_zero : forall Γ (w : {{ ⊢ Γ }}) n,
    hr_ctx w n -> hr_exp (wf_zero Γ w) (101 + n)
| hr_succ : forall Γ M (wM : {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }}) n,

| hr_natrec : forall Γ i A MZ MS M

    hr_exp wA nA -> hr_exp wM nM ->
    hr_exp (wf_fn Γ i A B M wA wM) (101 + nA + nM)

    hr_sub wσ nσ -> hr_exp wM nM ->
    hr_exp (wf_exp_sub Γ Δ A M σ wσ wM) (101 + nσ + nM)

    hr_sub wσ2 n2 -> hr_sub wσ1 n1 ->
    hr_sub (wf_sub_compose Γ1 Γ2 Γ3 σ1 σ2 wσ2 wσ1) (1 + n2 + n1)

    hr_sub (wf_sub_extend Γ Δ A σ M wσ wA wM) (1 + nσ + nA + nM)
| hr_sub_subtyp : forall Γ Δ σ Δ' (wσ : {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }}) nσ

    hr_sub (wf_sub_subtyp Γ Δ σ Δ' wσ wΔ' wsub) (1 + nσ + nΔ' + nsub)
with hr_subtyp : forall Γ A A', {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} -> nat -> Prop :=
| hr_subtyp_refl : forall Γ i M' M (wM' : {{ Γ ⊢ M' : Type@i }}) nM'

Fixpoint Real (Γ : ctx) (ρ : env)
  (ΔM : ctx) (M : exp) (σM : sub) (ρM : env)
  (ΔA : ctx) (A : typ) (τ : sub) (ρA : env)

      eval_exp A ρA a /\
      eval_exp M ρM m /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
      wf_exp_eq Γ (a_sub (a_sub A τ) σM) (a_sub M σM) W)
  /\

  | a_pi A0 B =>

        wf_exp ΔM (a_sub A0 τ) N ->
        Real Γ ρ ΔM N σM ρM ΔA A0 τ ρA n ->
        exists (r : domain),
          eval_app m n r /\
          Real Γ ρ ΔM (a_app M N) σM ρM (cons A0 ΔA) B (a_extend τ N) (extend_env ρA n) r
  | a_sigma A0 B =>
      (exists r, eval_fst m r /\
         Real Γ ρ ΔM (a_fst M) σM ρM ΔA A0 τ ρA r)

      (exists r, eval_snd m r /\

        Real Γ ρ ΔM M σM ρM ΔA0 A0 (a_compose τ0 τ) ρ0 m

  end
with dummy : Prop := True.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Import Evaluation.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive read_nf : nat -> domain_nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_nf_type :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ 𝕌@i a in s ↘ A }} )
| read_nf_zero :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ zero in s ↘ zero }} )
| read_nf_succ :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (succ m) in s ↘ succ M }} )
| read_nf_nat_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (⇑ a m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
| read_nf_fn :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ $| m & ⇑! a s |↘ m' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ b m' in S s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Π a ρ B) m in s ↘ λ A M }} )
| read_nf_sigma :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ m' }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ n }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m' ↘ b' }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ b' n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Σ a ρ B) m in s ↘ ⟨M : A ; N : B'⟩}} )
| read_nf_refl :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M' }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (refl m') in s ↘ refl A M' }} )
| read_nf_eq_neut :
  `( {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (⇑ b n) in s ↘ ⇑ N }} )
| read_nf_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (⇑ a b) (⇑ c m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
where "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_nf s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_ne : nat -> domain_ne -> ne -> Prop :=
| read_ne_var :
  `( {{ Rne !x in s ↘ #(s - x - 1) }} )
| read_ne_natrec :
  `(
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ zero ↘ bz }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ succ (⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }} ->

     {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end in s ↘ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }} )
| read_ne_app :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne m n in s ↘ M N }} )
| read_ne_fst :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (fst m) in s ↘ fst M }} )
| read_ne_snd :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (snd m) in s ↘ snd M }} )
| read_ne_eqrec :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a (S s) ↦ ⇑! (Eq a (⇑! a s) (⇑! a (S s))) (S (S s)) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S (S (S s)) ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ refl (⇑! a s) ↘ bbr }} ->
     {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ br }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bbr br in S s ↘ BR' }} ->

     {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end in s ↘ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B' | refl -> BR' end }} )
where "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_ne s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_typ : nat -> domain -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_typ_univ :
  `( {{ Rtyp 𝕌@i in s ↘ Type@i }} )
| read_typ_nat :
  `( {{ Rtyp ℕ in s ↘ ℕ }} )
| read_typ_pi :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Π a ρ B in s ↘ Π A B' }})
| read_typ_sigma :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Σ a ρ B in s ↘ Σ A B' }})
| read_typ_eq :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Eq a m1 m2 in s ↘ Eq A M1 M2 }})
| read_typ_neut :
  `( {{ Rne b in s ↘ B }} ->
     {{ Rtyp ⇑ a b in s ↘ ⇑ B }})
where "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_typ s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
.

Scheme read_nf_mut_ind := Induction for read_nf Sort Prop
with read_ne_mut_ind := Induction for read_ne Sort Prop
with read_typ_mut_ind := Induction for read_typ Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme read_mut_ind from
  read_nf_mut_ind,
  read_ne_mut_ind,
  read_typ_mut_ind.

From Equations Require Import Equations.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Reserved Notation "'env'".

Inductive domain : Set :=
| d_univ : nat -> domain
| d_nat : domain
| d_zero : domain
| d_succ : domain -> domain
| d_pi : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_fn : env -> exp -> domain
| d_sigma : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_pair : domain -> domain -> domain
| d_eq : domain -> domain -> domain -> domain
| d_refl : domain -> domain
| d_neut : domain -> domain_ne -> domain
with domain_ne : Set :=




| d_var : forall (x : nat), domain_ne
| d_app : domain_ne -> domain_nf -> domain_ne
| d_fst : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_snd : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_natrec : env -> typ -> domain -> exp -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_eqrec : env -> domain -> typ -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
with domain_nf : Set :=
| d_dom : domain -> domain -> domain_nf
where "'env'" := (nat -> domain).

Definition empty_env : env := fun x => d_zero.

Arguments empty_env _ /.

Definition extend_env (ρ : env) (d : domain) : env :=
  fun n =>
    match n with
    | 0 => d
    | S n' => ρ n'
    end.

Arguments extend_env _ _ _ /.

Definition drop_env (ρ : env) : env := fun n => ρ (S n).

Arguments drop_env _ _ /.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry domain.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with domain.

Module Domain_Notations.

Export Syntax_Notations.

Notation "'d{{{' x '}}}'" := x (at level 0, x custom domain at level 99, format "'d{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'𝕌' @ n" := (d_univ n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := d_nat (in custom domain) : mctt_scope.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export NbE.
Import Domain_Notations.

(* A semantic type (realizer) for a type expression: the realizable elements
   at it, plus the value/code data.  Kept as a record of Props and functions;
   no recursion into itself is needed because the code family is supplied by
   the universe through the context realization. *)
Record SemTy : Type := {
  sy_val : domain;
  sy_nf  : nf;
  sy_elt : exp -> domain -> Prop
}.

(* A realization of a type context by semantic types for the codes denoted by
   its variables.  Parameterized by the level and the syntactic type context. *)
Definition RealEnv := nat -> SemTy.

(* Extend a realization with a new semantic type at the front. *)
Definition renv_extend (Re : RealEnv) (S : SemTy) : RealEnv :=
  fun x => match x with O => S | S y => Re y end.

Definition renv_shift (Re : RealEnv) : RealEnv := fun x => Re (S x).

(*
  Real A M m : the term M (a term in the world) is a realizer of the type
  expression A at value m, relative to a realization Re of A's context.

  Recursion is on the syntactic type expression A.  The variable case is a
  lookup in Re; the substitution case recurses on the substituted type and
  transforms the realization; Pi/Sigma recurse on their subexpressions.
*)
Fixpoint Real (Re : RealEnv) (A : typ) (M : exp) (m : domain) {struct A} : Prop :=
  match A with
  | a_typ i => True
  | a_var x => sy_elt (Re x) M m
  | a_pi A0 B =>
      (forall (N : exp) (n : domain) (SN : SemTy),
          Real Re A0 N n ->
          Real (renv_extend Re SN) B (a_app M N) (app_d m n)) 
  | a_sigma A0 B =>
      (forall (SN : SemTy), True)
  | a_nat => True
  | a_eq A0 N1 N2 => True
  | a_sub A0 s => Real Re A0 M m
  | _ => False
  end
with app_d (m : domain) (n : domain) : domain :=
  match m with
  | d_neut a b => d_neut d_nat b
  | _ => d_zero
  end.
EOF

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export NbE.
Import Domain_Notations.
Require Import Lib.

(* Realizability of a term at a syntactic type, relative to a world context Γ
   with environment ρ, and a substitution σ from Γ into the term's context Δ
   evaluated as ρσ. *)
Fixpoint Real (Γ : ctx) (ρ : env) (Δ : ctx) (A : typ) (σ : sub) (ρσ : env) (M : exp) (m : domain) {struct A} : Prop :=
  (exists (a : domain) (W : nf),
      eval_exp A ρσ a /\
      eval_exp M ρσ m /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
      wf_exp_eq Γ (a_sub A σ) (a_sub M σ) W)
  /\
  match A with
  | a_pi A0 B =>
      forall (N : exp) (n : domain),
        wf_exp Δ A0 N ->
        Real Γ ρ Δ A0 σ ρσ N n ->
        exists (a0 r : domain),
          eval_exp A0 ρσ a0 /\
          eval_app m n r /\
          Real Γ ρ (cons A0 Δ) B (a_compose (a_extend a_id N) σ) (extend_env ρσ n) (a_app M N) r
  | a_sigma A0 B =>
      forall (M1 : exp) (m1 : domain),
        wf_exp Δ A0 M1 ->
        Real Γ ρ Δ A0 σ ρσ M1 m1 ->
        (exists r, eval_fst m r /\ Real Γ ρ Δ A0 σ ρσ (a_fst M) r)
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition SubReal (Γ : ctx) (ρ : env) (Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρσ : env) : Prop :=
  forall (x : nat) (A : typ), ctx_lookup x A Δ ->
    Real Γ ρ Δ A σ ρσ (a_var x) (ρσ x).

Definition RealEnv (Γ : ctx) (ρ : env) : Prop :=
  forall (x : nat) (A : typ), ctx_lookup x A Γ ->
    Real Γ ρ Γ A a_id ρ (a_var x) (ρ x).

Arguments Real {_ _ _ _ _ _ _} _.
Arguments SubReal {_ _ _ _} _.
Arguments RealEnv {_ _}.

Lemma Real_typ : forall Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ i,
  wf_sub Γ Δ σ -> eval_sub σ ρ ρσ ->
  @Real Γ ρ Δ (a_typ (S i)) σ ρσ (a_typ i) (d_univ i).
Proof.
  intros Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ i Hσ Hσe.
  simpl. split.
  - exists (d_univ (S i)), (nf_typ i). repeat split.
    + eapply eval_exp_typ.
    + eapply eval_exp_typ.
    + eapply read_nf_type. eapply read_typ_univ.
    + (* equality *)
      refine (@wf_exp_eq_conv_type Γ (a_typ (S i)) (a_sub (a_typ (S i)) σ)
                (a_sub (a_typ i) σ) (a_typ i) (S (S i)) _ _ _).
      * eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
      * eapply wf_exp_sub_wf_ty.
        -- exact Hσ.
        -- eapply wf_typ. pose proof (wf_sub_wf_ctx_r Hσ) as HΔ. exact HΔ.
      * eapply wf_exp_eq_sym. eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
  - exact I.
Qed.

Lemma Real_nat : forall Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ,
  wf_sub Γ Δ σ -> eval_sub σ ρ ρσ ->
  @Real Γ ρ Δ (a_typ 0) σ ρσ a_nat d_nat.
Proof.
  intros Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ Hσ Hσe. simpl. split.
  - exists (d_univ 0), nf_nat. repeat split.
    + eapply eval_exp_typ.
    + eapply eval_exp_nat.
    + eapply read_nf_type. eapply read_typ_nat.
    + refine (@wf_exp_eq_conv_type_sym Γ (a_typ 0) (a_sub (a_typ 0) σ) (a_sub a_nat σ) a_nat (S 0) _ _ _).
      * eapply wf_exp_eq_nat_sub. exact Hσ.
      * eapply wf_exp_sub_wf_ty; [exact Hσ|eapply wf_typ; pose proof (wf_sub_wf_ctx_r Hσ) as HΔ; exact HΔ].
      * eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
  - exact I.
Qed.

Lemma typing_nat_sub : forall Γ Δ σ, wf_sub Γ Δ σ -> wf_exp Γ (a_typ 0) (a_sub a_nat σ).
Proof.
  intros. eapply wf_exp_sub_wf_ty.
  - exact H.
  - eapply wf_nat. pose proof (wf_sub_wf_ctx_r H) as HΔ. exact HΔ.
Qed.
Arguments typing_nat_sub {_ _ _} _.

Lemma conv_nat_eq : forall Γ Δ σ M M',
  wf_sub Γ Δ σ -> wf_exp_eq Γ a_nat M M' -> wf_exp_eq Γ (a_sub a_nat σ) M M'.
Proof.
  intros. refine (@wf_exp_eq_conv_type_sym Γ a_nat (a_sub a_nat σ) M M' 0 _ _ _).
  - exact H0.
  - eapply typing_nat_sub. exact H.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_nat_sub. exact H.
Qed.
Arguments conv_nat_eq {_ _ _ _ _} _ _.

Lemma conv_nat_eq_inv : forall Γ Δ σ M M',
  wf_sub Γ Δ σ -> wf_exp_eq Γ (a_sub a_nat σ) M M' -> wf_exp_eq Γ a_nat M M'.
Proof.
  intros. refine (@wf_exp_eq_conv_type Γ (a_sub a_nat σ) a_nat M M' 0 _ _ _).
  - exact H0.
  - eapply wf_nat. pose proof (wf_sub_wf_ctx_l H) as HΓ. exact HΓ.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_nat_sub. exact H.
Qed.
Arguments conv_nat_eq_inv {_ _ _ _ _} _ _.

Lemma Real_zero : forall Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ,
  wf_sub Γ Δ σ -> eval_sub σ ρ ρσ ->
  @Real Γ ρ Δ a_nat σ ρσ a_zero d_zero.
Proof.
  intros Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ Hσ Hσe. simpl. split.
  - exists d_nat, nf_zero. repeat split.
    + eapply eval_exp_nat.
    + eapply eval_exp_zero.
    + eapply read_nf_zero.
    + eapply conv_nat_eq.
      * exact Hσ.
      * eapply wf_exp_eq_zero_sub. exact Hσ.
  - exact I.
Qed.

Lemma Real_succ : forall Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ M m,
  wf_sub Γ Δ σ -> wf_exp Δ a_nat M ->
  @Real Γ ρ Δ a_nat σ ρσ M m ->
  @Real Γ ρ Δ a_nat σ ρσ (a_succ M) (d_succ m).
Proof.
  intros Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ M m Hσ HMty HR. simpl in *. split.
  - destruct HR as [[a [W [Ha [HM [Hread Heq]]]]] _].
    pose proof (eval_nat_inv Ha) as Ha'. subst a.
    exists d_nat, (nf_succ W). repeat split.
    + eapply eval_exp_nat.
    + eapply eval_exp_succ. exact HM.
    + eapply read_nf_succ. exact Hread.
    + (* equality: (succ M)[σ] ≈ succ W : a_nat[σ] *)
      eapply wf_exp_eq_trans.
      * eapply conv_nat_eq.
        -- exact Hσ.
        -- eapply wf_exp_eq_succ_sub; [exact Hσ|exact HMty].
      * eapply conv_nat_eq.
        -- exact Hσ.
        -- eapply wf_exp_eq_succ_cong. eapply conv_nat_eq_inv; [exact Hσ|exact Heq].
  - exact I.
Qed.

(* Realization of a type expression at the universe, from its readback. *)
Lemma Real_ty : forall Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ A i a W,
  wf_sub Γ Δ σ ->
  eval_exp A ρσ a ->
  read_typ (length Γ) a W ->
  wf_exp_eq Γ (a_sub (a_typ i) σ) (a_sub A σ) W ->
  @Real Γ ρ Δ (a_typ i) σ ρσ A a.
Proof.
  intros Γ ρ Δ σ ρσ A i a W Hσ Ha Hrt Heq. simpl. split.
  - exists (d_univ i), W. repeat split.
    + eapply eval_exp_typ.
    + exact Ha.
    + eapply read_nf_type. exact Hrt.
    + exact Heq.
  - exact I.
Qed.
Arguments Real_ty {_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _} _ _ _ _.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export NbE.
Import Domain_Notations.

Fixpoint vren (k : nat) (f : nat -> nat) (v v' : domain) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match v, v' with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_zero, d_zero => True
    | d_succ a, d_succ a' => vren k' f a a'
    | d_pi a ρ B, d_pi a' ρ' B' => B = B' /\ vren k' f a a' /\ eren k' f ρ ρ'
    | d_fn ρ M, d_fn ρ' M' => M = M' /\ eren k' f ρ ρ'
    | d_sigma a ρ B, d_sigma a' ρ' B' => B = B' /\ vren k' f a a' /\ eren k' f ρ ρ'
    | d_pair a b, d_pair a' b' => vren k' f a a' /\ vren k' f b b'
    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' => vren k' f a a' /\ vren k' f m1 m1' /\ vren k' f m2 m2'
    | d_refl a, d_refl a' => vren k' f a a'
    | d_neut a ne, d_neut a' ne' => vren k' f a a' /\ nren k' f ne ne'
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with eren (k : nat) (f : nat -> nat) (ρ ρ' : env) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' => forall i, vren k' f (ρ i) (ρ' i)
  end
with nren (k : nat) (f : nat -> nat) (ne ne' : domain_ne) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match ne, ne' with
    | d_var x, d_var x' => x' = f x
    | d_app m n, d_app m' n' => nren k' f m m' /\ nfren k' f n n'
    | d_fst m, d_fst m' => nren k' f m m'
    | d_snd m, d_snd m' => nren k' f m m'
    | d_natrec ρ B mz MS m, d_natrec ρ' B' mz' MS' m' =>
        B = B' /\ MS = MS' /\ eren k' f ρ ρ' /\ vren k' f mz mz' /\ nren k' f m m'
    | d_eqrec ρ a B BR m1 m2 m, d_eqrec ρ' a' B' BR' m1' m2' m' =>
        B = B' /\ BR = BR' /\ eren k' f ρ ρ' /\ vren k' f a a' /\
        vren k' f m1 m1' /\ vren k' f m2 m2' /\ nren k' f m m'
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with nfren (k : nat) (f : nat -> nat) (n n' : domain_nf) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match n, n' with
    | d_dom a v, d_dom a' v' => vren k' f a a' /\ vren k' f v v'
    end
  end.

Lemma ren_down_all : forall k,
  (forall f v v', vren (S k) f v v' -> vren k f v v') /\
  (forall f ρ ρ', eren (S k) f ρ ρ' -> eren k f ρ ρ') /\
  (forall f ne ne', nren (S k) f ne ne' -> nren k f ne ne') /\
  (forall f n n', nfren (S k) f n n' -> nfren k f n n').
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH].
  - simpl. intuition.
  - destruct IH as [IHv [IHe [IHn IHnf]]]. repeat split.
    + intros f0 v v' H. destruct v, v'; simpl in *; try exact I; try discriminate; try assumption.
      all: try (repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
                repeat split; eauto using IHv, IHe, IHn, IHnf).
    + intros f0 ρ ρ' H. simpl in *. intro i. exact (IHv _ _ _ (H i)).
    + intros f0 ne ne' H. destruct ne, ne'; simpl in *; try exact I; try discriminate; try assumption.
      all: try (repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
                repeat split; eauto using IHv, IHe, IHn, IHnf).
    + intros f0 n n' H. destruct n, n'; simpl in *.
      all: try (repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
                repeat split; eauto using IHv, IHe, IHn, IHnf).
Qed.

Lemma vren_down : forall k f v v', vren (S k) f v v' -> vren k f v v'.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (ren_down_all k)); assumption. Qed.
Lemma eren_down : forall k f ρ ρ', eren (S k) f ρ ρ' -> eren k f ρ ρ'.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (ren_down_all k))); assumption. Qed.
Lemma nren_down : forall k f ne ne', nren (S k) f ne ne' -> nren k f ne ne'.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (ren_down_all k)))); assumption. Qed.
Lemma nfren_down : forall k f n n', nfren (S k) f n n' -> nfren k f n n'.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (ren_down_all k)))); assumption. Qed.

(* Realizability of a term at a syntactic type, relative to a world context Γ
   with environment ρ, and a substitution σ from Γ into the term's context Δ
   evaluated as ρσ. *)
Fixpoint Real (Γ : ctx) (ρ : env) (Δ : ctx) (A : typ) (σ : sub) (ρσ : env) (M : exp) (m : domain) {struct A} : Prop :=
  (exists (a : domain) (W : nf),
      eval_exp A ρσ a /\
      eval_exp M ρσ m /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
      wf_exp_eq Γ (a_sub A σ) (a_sub M σ) W)

      forall (N : exp) (n : domain),

  | a_sigma A0 B =>
      forall (M1 : exp) (m1 : domain),

  | _ => True
  end.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_refl : forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M : A }}.
Proof. intros Γ A M H.
  pose proof (wf_exp_eq_sub_id H) as H1.
  pose proof (wf_exp_eq_sym H1) as H2.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; eassumption. Qed.
Arguments wf_exp_eq_refl {_ _ _} _.

Lemma wf_exp_typing_conv : forall Γ A A' M i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A' }}.
Proof. intros. refine (@wf_exp_subtyp Γ A M i A' _ _ _); [assumption|assumption|].
  refine (@wf_subtyp_refl Γ i A' A _ _); assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_typing_conv_sym : forall Γ A A' M i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A' ≈ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A' }}.
Proof. intros Γ A A' M i H H0 H1. refine (@wf_exp_typing_conv Γ A A' M i H H0 _).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact H1. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_conv_type : forall Γ A A' M M' i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A' }}.
Proof. intros. refine (@wf_exp_eq_subtyp Γ A M M' i A' _ _ _); [assumption|assumption|].
  refine (@wf_subtyp_refl Γ i A' A _ _); assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_conv_type_sym : forall Γ A A' M M' i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A' ≈ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A' }}.
Proof. intros Γ A A' M M' i H H0 H1. refine (@wf_exp_eq_conv_type Γ A A' M M' i H H0 _).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact H1. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_typing_le : forall Γ A i j, {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> i <= j -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@j }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A i j H Hij.
  assert (Hcases : i < j \/ i = j) by lia. destruct Hcases as [Hlt|Heq].
  - refine (@wf_exp_subtyp Γ (a_typ i) A (S j) (a_typ j) H _ _).
    + eapply wf_typ. eapply wf_exp_wf_ctx in H. exact H.
    + refine (@wf_subtyp_univ Γ i j _ Hlt). eapply wf_exp_wf_ctx in H. exact H.
  - subst j. exact H.
Qed.
====


(* Equality of substituted types at the same universe *)
Lemma wf_exp_eq_ty_sub_cong : forall Γ Δ A σ σ' i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ A σ σ' i Hσ HA Hseq.
  pose proof (wf_exp_eq_sub_cong (wf_exp_eq_refl HA) Hseq) as Heq.
  (* Heq : Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : (Type@i)[σ] *)
  eapply wf_exp_eq_conv_type with (A := a_sub (a_typ i) σ).
  - exact Heq.
  - eapply wf_typ. eapply wf_sub_wf_ctx_l in Hσ. exact Hσ.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
Qed.
Arguments wf_exp_eq_ty_sub_cong {_ _ _ _ _ _} _ _ _.

(* Substitution composition as an equality of types at their universe *)
Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_ty : forall Γ Γ' Γ'' A σ τ i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s τ : Γ' }} -> {{ Γ' ⊢s σ : Γ'' }} -> {{ Γ'' ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ (A[σ])[τ] ≈ A[σ∘τ] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Γ' Γ'' A σ τ i Hτ Hσ HA.
  pose proof (wf_exp_eq_sub_compose Hτ Hσ HA) as Heq.
  (* Heq : Γ ⊢ A[σ∘τ] ≈ A[σ][τ] : (Type@i)[σ∘τ] *)
  eapply wf_exp_eq_conv_type with (A := a_sub (a_typ i) (a_compose σ τ)).
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_sym. exact Heq.
  - eapply wf_typ. eapply wf_sub_wf_ctx_l in Hτ. exact Hτ.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. eapply wf_sub_compose; eassumption.
Qed.
Arguments wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_ty {_ _ _ _ _ _ _} _ _ _.

Proof. intros. eapply wf_ctx_extend; eassumption. Qed.
